concepts.anchor_rule: Place the anchor at the midpoint of the supported boundary segment.
concepts.box_rule: Enclose the supported segment and nearby contrasting pixels on both sides, without extrapolating its ends.
concepts.definition: A roughly vertical intensity boundary with dark pixels on the left and a brighter strip or region on the right.

negatives.evidence: The visible upright transition has its darker region on the right.

positives.evidence: A bright upright strip borders a black region on its left.
The visible bright region has a near-vertical left edge beside black pixels.

concepts.support_rule: Require a vertically sustained transition with visible contrast on both sides. Exclude transitions caused by the observation window; equality to exterior gray alone does not establish visibility.

concepts.anchor_rule: Place the anchor at the midpoint of the supported boundary segment.
concepts.box_rule: Enclose the visible transition and a narrow neighborhood on both sides.
concepts.definition: A roughly vertical intensity boundary with a brighter region on the left and a dark region on the right.

negatives.evidence: The bright upright strip lies to the right of the black region.

positives.evidence: A pale upright strip meets black pixels along its right side.
A faint light vertical margin borders the black area to its right.
Below the bright ledge, a light vertical strip runs beside black pixels on the right.

concepts.support_rule: Require sustained vertical contrast inside supported visible content. Do not use a window edge or infer continuation beyond the crop.

concepts.anchor_rule: Anchor at the strongest supported bend between the rising and upright portions.
concepts.box_rule: Enclose the visible curved shoulder and local contrast on each side.
concepts.definition: A curved boundary rising toward the right and bending toward an upright left margin, with darkness above-left and brighter material below-right.

negatives.evidence: The curved shoulder descends toward the right, with black on the upper-right side.

positives.evidence: A pale shoulder curves upward to the right from a near-vertical left margin against black.
The bright patch emerges beneath a curved boundary that rises to the right.
The bright left margin rounds inward near its upper visible portion.

concepts.support_rule: Require an actual curved intensity transition within the visible content. A cropped straight segment alone is insufficient, and no hidden top or side is implied.

concepts.anchor_rule: Anchor at the supported bend between the descending curve and upright margin.
concepts.box_rule: Enclose the curved transition and adjacent contrasting pixels without completing a larger outline.
concepts.definition: A curved boundary descending toward the right and bending into an upright right margin, with brighter material below-left and darkness above-right.

negatives.evidence: The visible shoulder rises toward the right and has darkness above-left.

positives.evidence: The pale region rounds downward along its upper-right edge against black.
A curved pale shoulder slopes down toward an upright right edge.
The upper bright region narrows into a rounded right margin beside black.

concepts.support_rule: Require visible curvature and the specified contrast orientation inside the observation. Ignore mask boundaries.

concepts.anchor_rule: Anchor at the midpoint of the supported bright ridge.
concepts.box_rule: Enclose the ridge, a small portion of the region above, and the darker pixels below.
concepts.definition: A narrow, approximately horizontal bright band along the lower edge of a lighter region, with darker pixels immediately below.

negatives.evidence: The prominent bright boundary is an upper cap with black above.

positives.evidence: A bright horizontal strip runs beneath the pale vertically shaded area.
A pale horizontal lower rim lies above a dark band.
The bright upright region turns into a horizontal luminous lower edge above black.
A bright lower band extends beneath the small dark interior patches.

concepts.support_rule: Require a local horizontal brightness ridge and visible lower-side contrast. Do not treat the bottom of the observation window as a rim or infer unseen endpoints.

concepts.anchor_rule: Anchor at the midpoint of the supported dark groove centerline.
concepts.box_rule: Enclose the visible groove and its bright flanks; stop at the limits of observed support.
concepts.definition: A narrow, elongated dark groove running approximately vertically within a brighter local surround.

negatives.evidence: The black area beside the bright strip is broad and lacks a bright flank on its other side.

positives.evidence: A thin black upright groove is flanked by pale vertical ridges.
A short narrow dark vertical groove lies within the brighter upright strip.
A compact elongated dark mark appears inside the bright region near its right side.

concepts.support_rule: Require a dark center with brighter support on both lateral sides over an elongated segment. Do not infer closure or true endpoints from cropping.

concepts.anchor_rule: Anchor at the deepest supported point of the indentation.
concepts.box_rule: Enclose the indentation and its adjacent bright shoulders, including its visible connection to darkness below.
concepts.definition: A localized dark indentation projecting upward into a brighter region from its lower visible boundary.

negatives.evidence: The visible bright cap has no supported upward dark indentation.

positives.evidence: A small dark triangular indentation rises into the lower part of the bright patch.
A dark upward-pointing indentation interrupts the bright lower boundary.
A dark notch rises from beneath the bright region, left of the upright dark mark.

concepts.support_rule: Require a visible connection between the indentation and the lower dark region. Do not classify a cropped gap or isolated dark spot as a connected notch.

concepts.anchor_rule: Anchor at the supported crest of the upper boundary.
concepts.box_rule: Enclose the visible cap arc, dark support above, and bright support below; do not include inferred lower structure.
concepts.definition: A locally convex bright upper boundary that rises from the left, passes through a shallow crest, and descends to the right, with dark pixels above.

negatives.evidence: The bright upper ridge is broken into irregular bumps rather than a smooth cap.

positives.evidence: A smooth bright upper arc rises to a shallow rounded crest against black.
The bright region has a broad rounded upper contour with a visible descent on the right.

concepts.support_rule: Require both sides of a local crest to be visible. This describes an upper arc only and does not imply a closed shape.

concepts.anchor_rule: Anchor at the midpoint of the supported oblique transition.
concepts.box_rule: Enclose the supported diagonal segment and nearby contrasting pixels on both sides.
concepts.definition: An oblique boundary rising toward the right, with brighter pixels above-right and darker pixels below-left.

negatives.evidence: The upper shoulder descends toward the right and has darkness above-right.

positives.evidence: A pale diagonal edge rises to the right above a black lower-left region.
Left of the upright bright section, a slanted pale boundary separates brighter upper-right pixels from black below-left.

concepts.support_rule: Require an oblique transition inside visible content with the stated sidedness. Do not use diagonal arrangements of mask corners or extrapolate the segment.

concepts.anchor_rule: Anchor at the midpoint along the supported irregular ridge.
concepts.box_rule: Enclose the connected or closely grouped bright ridge elements and immediate dark context.
concepts.definition: A short uneven ridge of bright bumps or flecks against a dark region, with visibly varying brightness or height along its length.

negatives.evidence: The bright upper arc is comparatively smooth and continuous.

positives.evidence: Several bright bumps form an uneven shallow arch against black.
The upper visible ridge contains bright irregular highlights separated by darker dips.
A short sloping ridge contains several uneven bright patches against darkness.
A bumpy bright ridge lies above a darker horizontal region.

concepts.support_rule: Require multiple visible brightness peaks or contour irregularities. Do not join fragments across masked areas or assume a complete larger contour.

concepts.anchor_rule: Anchor at the center of the supported dark-mark group.
concepts.box_rule: Enclose the dark marks, their pale surround, and the associated bright band below.
concepts.definition: One or more compact dark marks interrupt a pale local area immediately above a brighter, approximately horizontal band.

negatives.evidence: The bright lower band is accompanied by diffuse vertical shading rather than compact dark patches.

positives.evidence: A small dark mark and a larger angular dark patch sit above a bright horizontal lower band.
Dark block-like patches appear immediately above a narrow pale horizontal strip.

concepts.support_rule: Require visible dark-to-pale contrast and a separately supported band below. Do not require enclosed holes or infer the shapes behind the crop.

concepts.anchor_rule: Anchor at the midpoint of the supported lighter separating strip.
concepts.box_rule: Enclose the visible strip and adjacent darker bands, limited to their observed horizontal extent.
concepts.definition: A roughly horizontal lighter strip separates darker horizontal regions above and below.

positives.evidence: Below the irregular bright ridge, a muted horizontal strip separates a dark upper band from a darker lower region.

concepts.support_rule: Require a supported vertical sequence of dark, lighter, and dark intensities across a horizontal span. Reject window boundaries as band evidence; this candidate remains provisional with one supporting observation.
